concept: Lotería de la Cantina, a real tabla of four cards locked in a 2 x 2 grid with shared rows, read in rows. Row 1: El Cantarito (44, cocktails) | El Barril (9, beer & cider); row 2: La Rosa (41, wine) | La Botella (8, agave & brandy). Every card: 3 pt frame in its colour; one face template (the Don Clemente number as a 19 pt italic numeral in the card colour at the face's top-left, a cut-paper figure, the cantor verse beside it, and a full-width 24 pt name band at the foot of the face carrying the card name in 18 pt caps). Both cards in a row share one face height and one figure scale, so their name bands and first subheads sit on one line; the shorter card of a row closes the difference with a card foot (thin rule + 'Nº n · NAME' in the card colour). The drinks list sits below under the draft's own subheads, SPANISH · English, 8.5 pt tracked caps in the card colour.

page.bleed: none (cream flood to trim, home/office print)

grid.rows: Locked 2 x 2 tabla with shared rows: columns 264 / 264 pt, 12 pt gutter = 12 pt row gap. Row 1: El Cantarito (44, cocktails) | El Barril (9, beer & cider); row 2: La Rosa (41, wine) | La Botella (8, agave & brandy). Row heights 366 / 252 pt; deck 630 pt from y = 126 to 756 pt on a 6 pt grid; both columns end at 756 pt. One item pitch on every card (6 pt item gap, 12 pt lines). One face per row: {'row1': 99, 'row2': 99} pt (figures {1: 63, 2: 63, 3: 63, 4: 63} pt). Card feet: {1: 0, 2: 84, 3: 0, 4: 0} pt. Rhythm on every card: 12 pt from the name band to the first subhead, 12 pt above every later subhead, 6 pt below every subhead, 6 pt item gap, 12 pt lines. Every card top, face, band, subhead and item row sits on the 6 pt baseline grid from the deck top.
grid.card_anatomy: 3 pt frame in the card colour; face ({1: 99.0, 2: 99.0, 3: 99.0, 4: 99.0} pt; one height per row, + 3 pt frame = a multiple of 6) = tinted panel (10 % of the card colour) with a 0.75 pt inset hairline at 3 pt; the Don Clemente number as a Fraunces 700 italic 19/24 pt numeral in the card colour at the face's top-left (a 24 pt numeral column), the square cut-paper figure (face - 36 pt: {1: [63.0, 63.0], 2: [63.0, 63.0], 3: [63.0, 63.0], 4: [63.0, 63.0]} pt, one scale per row) at x = 33 pt inside the card, the cantor verse (Fraunces italic 10/12 pt, centred) beside it, 6 pt, then a full-width 24 pt name band (card name Fraunces 700 18 pt caps, gloss Fraunces italic 8 pt: Cocktails, Beer & Cider, Wine, Spirits); 12 pt; list; on the shorter card of a row a card foot (0.75 pt rule in the card colour, 5.25 pt, then 'Nº n · NAME' 7.5 pt tracked caps in the card colour on the last 12 pt line); 9 pt bottom padding + 3 pt frame = 12 pt.

type.display: Fraunces 700 24/30 pt title at y = 72 pt (30 pt papel picado above, 36-66 pt), tagline DM Sans 500 8.5/12 pt tracked caps at y = 108 pt (a full 6 pt step below the title line box), deck top y = 126 pt
type.card_numbers: Fraunces 700 italic 19/24 pt in the card colour (burnt ochre #8A5A00 on La Botella for contrast), top-left of the face; phone 18 px, under the 19 px prices
type.prices: Fraunces 700 11.5/12 pt, tnum + lnum, in the card colour (terracotta, agave green, rosa); ink on La Botella
type.price_label: 'copa' DM Sans italic 7.5 pt muted, 4 pt left of the Malbec and Pinot Grigio prices
type.band_gloss: Fraunces italic 8 pt, title case: Cocktails, Beer & Cider, Wine, Spirits
type.descriptions: DM Sans 8/12 pt ink, text-wrap pretty, last two words bound, stacked under the name on all 14 items, one pattern per card (cocktails: lead + ingredients; beer, cider, wine: 'Style · serve' tag; spirits: 'category, poured straight.'); one measure per card = 237 pt text column - price column (14 pt; 36 pt on La Rosa with 'copa') - 18 pt; cocktails add the serve cue on its own line, DM Sans italic 8/12 pt muted
type.verse: Fraunces italic 10/12 pt muted, every card
type.subheads: one bilingual pattern on every card: SPANISH in DM Sans 700 caps 8.5/12 pt tracked 1.6 pt, a middle dot, then the English gloss in DM Sans 500 8.5 pt; all in the card colour (burnt ochre #8A5A00 on La Botella), rule in the same colour
type.name_bar: full-width 24 pt band at the foot of the face: terracotta (El Cantarito), agave green (El Barril), rosa (La Rosa) with cream text; marigold (La Botella) with ink text

elements.text: Tanto va el cántaro al agua, que se quiebra y te moja las enaguas.
Bright and citrus-forward: tequila blanco, fresh lime, orange liqueur and agave syrup.
Stirred: brown butter-washed bourbon, demerara syrup and aromatic bitters.
Shaken: white rum, fresh lime and house demerara syrup.
Tanto bebió el albañil, que quedó como barril.
Rosita, Rosaura, ven que te quiero ahora.

accent_contrast.note: rosa is one of the four card colours (La Rosa frame, cartouche, rule) and a papel picado colour; cream on rosa cartouche

measured_checks.face_tint_rule: every face = 10 % of its card colour over the card paper #FBF5EA
measured_checks.no_orphan_cue_note: a cue passes only if it sits on its own line under the ingredients (shares_line_with_description = false), on one line (lines = 1), with no one-word last line anywhere
measured_checks.masthead_note: papel picado 36-66 pt, title line box 72-102 pt, a full 6 pt step, tagline line box 108-120 pt, 6 pt, deck top 126 pt: all on 6 pt steps from the page top; the glyph boxes are measured above
measured_checks.face_template_note: same template on every card: 24 pt numeral column at the face top-left, figure at x = 33 pt, verse column at x = 108 pt, 6 pt, 24 pt band under; one face height per row (99 pt on every card this round); figure = face - 36 pt
